title: DiCE-Extended: A Robust Approach to Counterfactual Explanations in Machine Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness and stability of counterfactual explanations in explainable AI (XAI). While it briefly mentions 'fairness' and 'ethical implications' as general challenges in the field, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its research.
